title: MQSET: an attribute update whose selector and integer attribute are one-word blocks, on a queue opened for set
shapes: MQSA MQSASET: CALL 'MQSET' USING WS-HCONN WS-HOBJ WS-SEL-COUNT WS-SEL-BLOCK WS-INT-COUNT WS-INT-BLOCK WS-CHAR-LEN WS-CHAR-ATTRS WS-COMPCODE WS-REASON
asserts: MQSASET's MQSET CALL is one call_sites fact (resolves_to null) with a call edge and a gaps entry; the selector word WS-SEL-INHIBIT and the integer attribute WS-INHIBIT-PUT are data_items (S9(9) COMP with VALUE 6 and 1). MQSET is a different verb from MQINQ, which shares its USING shape.

citations.quote: Use the MQSET call to change the attributes of an object represented by a handle. The object must be a queue.
